name: Home Graph
description: Turns the home page into the global graph of your garden: every published note as a node, links as edges, click to open.
author: Ole Eskild Steensen

settings.name: Placement
settings.description: replace: the graph is the home page (note title and content are hidden). above / below: the graph is shown together with the home note's content.

settings.name: Height
settings.description: CSS height of the graph area, e.g. 80vh, 600px or calc(100vh - 8rem).

settings.name: Always show titles
settings.description: Show every note title at all zoom levels. Off: titles fade in as you zoom, and on hover, like the core graph.

settings.name: Hide sidebar on home page
settings.description: Hide the right-hand sidebar (local graph, table of contents, backlinks) on the home page.
